question: Who was the teacher of the famous musician Tansen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Haridas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swami Haridas: **A revered **saint and classical musician** in **Hindu tradition**.
 
• **Swami Haridas** was **Tansen's teacher**, a renowned musician in I**ndian classical music**.
 
• **Tansen**, a prominent composer, served in the **court of Mughal Emperor Akbar**.
 
• **Haridas' influence on Tansen c**ontributed to his emergence as one of the most celebrated **musicians in Indian classical music histor**y.
 
• 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravidas**

 
 
• **Saint and poet** from the **Bhakti movement**.
 
• Known for his **spiritual teachings and devotional poetry**.
 
• Advocated for **social equality and unity**.
 
• His verses are included in the **Sikh scripture Guru Granth Sahib**.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas**
 
 
• **Classical Sanskrit writer**.
 
• Renowned for his **plays and poetry**.
 
• **Authored **famous works like **"Shakuntala" **and** "Meghaduta."**
 
• Known for his **mastery of language and intricate storytelling**.
 
 
 
• **Surdas**
 
 
• **15th-century blind saint**,** poet, and musician**.
 
• Known for his **devotional songs** dedicated to** Lord Krishna**.
 
• His works reflect deep **spiritual devotion and love for Krishna**.
 
• His compositions are integral to the **Bhakti movement**.
